typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		BGBG_ID as string,
		BLIV_ID as string,
		DUE as string,
		BLIV_CREATE_DTM as string,
		GRGR_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> InputPlaceHolderOracleSource
InputPlaceHolderOracleSource derive({Copy of BLIV_CREATE_DTM} = BLIV_CREATE_DTM,
		{Copy of DUE} = DUE) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of DUE} as string,
		{Copy of BLIV_CREATE_DTM} as string,
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		{Copy of DUE},
		{Copy of BLIV_CREATE_DTM},
		{})) ~> OutputPlaceHolderOracleDestination
